_notes.about: Generic privacy patterns used by tools/privacy.py and the person installer. Per-person rules belong in privacy-terms.local.json in the context home, outside this repository. The CI deny gate uses ci/config.json independently.
_notes.patterns: Case-insensitive patterns for identifiers and secret assignments. Example e-mail domains are reserved for documentation. Add person, company, client and product names only to the local file.
_notes.forbidden_layer_repos: Optional local repository-name patterns that an install refuses to attach. Generic installs have no person-specific repository names.
_notes.personal_levels: Levels whose repositories must belong to the person's own account.
